keyword_definitions.title: Flux
keyword_definitions.definition: Your score. You win when you reach 20 Flux after a card fully resolves.

keyword_definitions.title: Sync
keyword_definitions.definition: Your remaining integrity. You lose if it stays at 0 after reactions and triggered effects finish.

keyword_definitions.title: Bandwidth
keyword_definitions.definition: A spendable resource used for Bandwidth costs. At each Start, it refreshes to a maximum that increases by 1.

keyword_definitions.title: Ki
keyword_definitions.definition: A resource that starts at 0. A minimum Ki requirement is only a threshold; a Ki cost is spent when the card is played or activated.

keyword_definitions.title: Uplink
keyword_definitions.definition: A non-spent threshold that starts at 0 and increases by 1 at each of your Start phases.

keyword_definitions.title: Pulse
keyword_definitions.definition: A card type that resolves, then moves from the battlefield to its controller's Discard.

keyword_definitions.title: Daemon
keyword_definitions.definition: A card type that remains on its controller's battlefield after it resolves.

keyword_definitions.title: Agent
keyword_definitions.definition: A card type that remains on the battlefield and takes damage using its Integrity.

keyword_definitions.title: Integrity
keyword_definitions.definition: An Agent's durability. An Agent at 0 Integrity is deleted.

keyword_definitions.title: Named Agent
keyword_definitions.definition: An Agent whose card name is formatted as Name, Title. Named Agents with the same Name may coexist; other play restrictions still apply.

keyword_definitions.title: Breach
keyword_definitions.definition: During your opponent's End Phase, this Agent deals the listed amount of damage. Damage targets opposing Agents first, then Sync if no Agent remains.

keyword_definitions.title: Signature
keyword_definitions.definition: A card subtype that cannot be included in decks. Agents can have multiple Signatures. An Agent may add each named Signature card to its controller's hand during that player's End Phase; Signature cards are played normally from hand.

keyword_definitions.title: Immutable
keyword_definitions.definition: A singleton card played before turn one without activating. Once on the battlefield, it cannot be moved, removed, deleted, or targeted.

keyword_definitions.title: Glitch
keyword_definitions.definition: A reaction card played from hand on either turn for its specified event, then moved directly to Discard.

keyword_definitions.title: Mission
keyword_definitions.definition: You may control only one Mission at a time. An attempt to add or play a Mission fails if another copy of that Mission is already in your hand or on your battlefield, or if you have completed a copy of that Mission this battle. A Mission checks for completion at the start of your turn, after the draw phase. A completed Mission resolves its Complete instruction, then is deleted. Each mission can only be played once per battle.

keyword_definitions.title: Goal
keyword_definitions.definition: A Mission's progress target. At the start of its controller's turn, after the draw phase, advance the Goal by 1 up to its printed value; when the Mission's requirement is satisfied, resolve Complete and delete the Mission.

keyword_definitions.title: Module
keyword_definitions.definition: A Daemon subtype that attaches to a card when it enters play. A Module remains on the battlefield until its effect deletes it or another effect deletes it. If its attached Agent is deleted, the Module is deleted too.

keyword_definitions.title: Charged Jutsu
keyword_definitions.definition: A public zone for Glitch Jutsu. A Charged Jutsu is not on the battlefield, does not form Signs, and does not pay its printed cost when it is resolved from the Charged Jutsu zone as a reaction.

keyword_definitions.title: Jutsu
keyword_definitions.definition:
This card can be played only as a Prepared Jutsu.

To resolve a Prepared Jutsu, form its Signs in order over any number of turns. When a Prepared Jutsu resolves, delete it.

Whenever you play a non-Jutsu card, form the next Sign in the sequence. If that card has one of the following types, form the corresponding additional Sign. Form that Sign first if able; otherwise, form it second. Starting a Jutsu is a card play, but does not form a Sign.

Agent — Ram
Daemon — Ox
Pulse — Tiger
Glitch — Snake

When a Glitch Jutsu has had its Signs formed, move it to the Charged Jutsu zone. It can be resolved as a reaction from that zone.

keyword_definitions.title: Prepared Jutsu
keyword_definitions.definition: A Jutsu placed face up beneath Ninjutsu. To resolve a Prepared Jutsu, form its Signs in order over any number of turns. When a Prepared Jutsu resolves, delete it.

keyword_definitions.title: Signs
keyword_definitions.definition: A sequence that must be completed in order to resolve a Prepared Jutsu. A Jutsu with no Signs cost is resolved immediately after it is prepared, except that a Glitch Jutsu moves to Charged Jutsu after its Sign sequence is complete.

keyword_definitions.title: Ram
keyword_definitions.definition: A Sign. Affiliated with Agent cards.

keyword_definitions.title: Ox
keyword_definitions.definition: A Sign. Affiliated with Daemon cards.

keyword_definitions.title: Tiger
keyword_definitions.definition: A Sign. Affiliated with Pulse cards.

keyword_definitions.title: Snake
keyword_definitions.definition: A Sign. Affiliated with Glitch cards.

keyword_definitions.title: Delete
keyword_definitions.definition: Move a card from its controller's battlefield to that player's Discard without resolving it again.

keyword_definitions.title: Wipe
keyword_definitions.definition: Move a card to its controller's Void instead of its Discard.

keyword_definitions.title: Discard
keyword_definitions.definition: A public zone that holds discarded cards and most cards after they resolve or are deleted.

keyword_definitions.title: Void
keyword_definitions.definition: A zone separate from Discard. Effects that target Discard cannot target cards in the Void.

keyword_definitions.title: Damage
keyword_definitions.definition: Damage hits an opposing Agent when possible; only a player with no Agents loses Sync from it.

keyword_definitions.title: Activate
keyword_definitions.definition: Resolve an eligible Immutable card's activation from the battlefield without moving it.

keyword_definitions.title: Passive
keyword_definitions.definition: A passive Immutable has no activation and cannot be selected by an Activate action.
